title: Charleston Haunted Booze and Boos Ghost Walking Tour
includes: Stories of local hauntings and ghosts
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
All guests must be 21+ with valid ID
Not recommended for travelers with mobility issues
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Your pirate guide will lead the group on a 2.5-hour walking tour through historic downtown Charleston. You will begin and end at a bar, each housed in historic buildings with their own unique ghosts and stories. Guests will have time to purchase and enjoy a delicious libation as the guide tells them all about the fascinating history of Charleston and some of its most famous and creepy haunted stories!

Please keep in mind that there will be a lot of walking between drinks stops where your guide will share the haunted history of several landmarks along the way. Per city law, Alcohol must NEVER be taken out of the bar.
*Tour route and drink stops are subject to availability. 
*All guests must be 21+ with Valid ID. Alcohol is not included.
*Some of the bars we visit may require guests to be 23+ to consume alcohol. While we will do our best to select alternative options for those under 23, we cannot guarantee accommodations. We strictly adhere to each bar’s policy without exception.
